faq.q: What is the '95 Grotti Cheetah in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a mid-1990s Grotti sports car included as a Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition benefit. Rockstar's official edition material confirms the manufacturer, 1995 model year and its inclusion in the edition.

faq.q: How is the '95 Grotti Cheetah obtained?
faq.a: It is included with the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition. Rockstar has not described a separate way to buy or unlock the car.

faq.q: Does the '95 Grotti Cheetah come with anything else?
faq.a: Rockstar's official screenshot archive shows four images specifically titled for the vehicle, but the edition material does not pair it with an additional item the way some other Ultimate Edition vehicles are bundled with a garage.

faq.q: Is the '95 Grotti Cheetah modeled on a real sports car?
faq.a: Rockstar does not state a specific real-world vehicle as its basis in the cited official material. Third-party visual comparisons exist but are not treated as official identification.

faq.q: What is the top speed and price of the '95 Grotti Cheetah?
faq.a: Rockstar has not verified performance statistics, purchase price, handling characteristics or full customization options, since the game has not released. Only its manufacturer, model year and edition status are confirmed.

notKnown: Final performance statistics and handling characteristics
